relevant_controls_reviewed: G6 response status distinguishes completed, timeout, provider_error, policy_violation, and invalid.
Failures remain in the all-planned denominator and cannot be deleted or converted into successful decisions.
Correctness is evaluated on the same paired task lineage and theory-family cluster; replicates are not independent laws.
design_alignment_review.alignment_conclusion: The repaired status guard and correctness predicate implement the design's failure-retention and all-planned rules without making any scientific claim.

before_repair.command: Read-only synthetic probe with status=provider_error and decision=MAINTAIN against expected_decision=MAINTAIN
before_repair.result: FAIL_OPEN: the response input was accepted and the old decision-only predicate returned true

after_repair.command: Read-only missing-status, unknown-completed-decision, and provider_error-with-matching-decision probes
after_repair.result: Missing/invalid completed fields fail closed; non-completed matching decision returns false

repair.change: Added registered response statuses and decisions, validated response status/parsed decision fields, and counted only completed responses as correct.

real_corrected_response_probe.command: Read-only validate_statistical_inputs on corrected G6 plan/private/responses with formal dimensions and status counts
real_corrected_response_probe.result: PASS: 552 plan rows, 552 responses, all 552 response statuses completed, and no input-contract error

findings.title: G6 clustered analysis could count a failed response with a matching decision as correct
findings.evidence: The pre-repair decision-only predicate ignored response.status and accepted a provider_error row with a matching decision.
findings.remediation: Validate registered response statuses and require status=completed for a correct decision.

ledger.note: The local response-status guard is fixed and independently verified; provider authorization, provenance, independent statistical/mathematical/dependency review, historical G7 validity, and remote delivery blockers remain.

git.note: Commit and push status will be recorded after the audit/state update; no remote update is presumed.
